plugins.name: windfall-way-scenario-skill
plugins.description: Co-authoring narrative scenarios for policy workshops on AI and economic change. Four skills: scenario-generation runs the whole pipeline in one pass; scenario-concepting produces the brief and candidate worlds; scenario-drafting writes and tunes the narrative; scenario-stress-testing pressure-tests a draft before it meets a room.
